sources.scope: Shared Polish frontier geometry and survey tripoints

processing: City boroughs cleaned together and clipped to their own reconciled municipal land. No separately generalized national boundary is retained. The local mesh is simplified together at two metres; district and region outlines are dissolved from it. Complete national arcs are anchored at verified survey tripoints; original surveys and independent junction evidence are retained.
